xi...@waste.org (Xian) wrote:
> Just because you're the DejaNews man, LSJ...
>
> Using the DN email account, is there a way to set up a reply-to address?

Not for the "write mail" screen, no.

But you should be able to provide a "Reply-To:" header when posting
by using the "power post" form (rather than the "quick post" form).

If you need to just send e-mail (without actually posting), post
to misc.test while CC'ing your recipient, then go cancel the
post. That should work almost as well.
